strings.name: Greg Brockman
strings.summary: Brockman moved from software engineering and Stripe technology management into AI entrepreneurship. He helped establish OpenAI's engineering organization and product platforms, including ChatGPT. He returned after the 2023 board crisis and a 2024 leave. Still president in 2026, his personal political donations drew AI-governance debate, distinct from the teams' scientific work.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Cofounded OpenAI and helped build its technology platforms and engineering organization, influencing the commercialization of generative AI.
strings.facts.f1.label: Upbringing
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Studied mathematics at Harvard and computer science at MIT; completed neither degree
strings.highlights.h1.title: Building AI engineering platforms
strings.highlights.h1.text: He helped establish the research and engineering organization that turned team research into public and developer products.
strings.highlights.h2.title: AI policy debates
strings.highlights.h2.text: Personal donations prompted safety and regulation debates; OpenAI says his private advocacy does not represent company policy.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Additional donation pledge withdrawn
strings.timeline.t1.text: Reports said he cancelled another $25 million for Leading the Future; the couple had already donated that amount.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Musk lawsuit dismissed
strings.timeline.t2.text: A jury found the suit untimely and the court dismissed claims against OpenAI and its leaders on that basis, without deciding every underlying factual dispute.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Returning after leave
strings.timeline.t3.text: He ended roughly three months away and resumed work as president.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Resignation and return
strings.timeline.t4.text: After Altman's removal he resigned, then returned with the leadership team.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Team launches ChatGPT
strings.timeline.t5.text: The company he helped lead released a conversational-model preview, built by research, engineering and feedback teams.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Cofounding OpenAI
strings.timeline.t6.text: As its first technology lead, he helped establish the nonprofit AI research organization.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Stripe CTO
strings.timeline.t7.text: After joining in 2010, he became CTO and led payments-platform engineering.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Sixth in Science Talent Search
strings.timeline.t8.text: His mathematics work on Ducci sequences earned a US scholarship.
